An existing collaboration delivering less than expected

Sometimes the capability exists, but the working arrangements hold it back.

The situation

A Japanese enterprise and its Indian delivery partner have capable teams, yet approvals are slow and rework is recurring. Each side has a different explanation for the problems.

How SetuHashi could help

Examine workflows and expectations on both sides, identify where decisions stall and help the parties agree on changes to responsibilities, acceptance criteria and escalation.

What the assignment could produce

A shared diagnosis, revised working arrangements and a tracked improvement programme.

The intended value

A clearer understanding of what limits performance and a practical basis for improving it.

Related services

  • Improve existing collaborations
